description:
Welcome to the Cobian Affiliate Program, one of the best affiliate programs for those seeking to promote high-quality sandals and footwear. For nearly 30 years, Cobian has been the trusted, family-friendly brand for sandals and footwear, perfect for those who embrace an active outdoor lifestyle. Our legacy of exceptional Comfort, Quality, and Value has made Cobian a top choice for families and outdoor enthusiasts alike. From casual sandals and flip flops to warm, fuzzy slippers, our footwear is designed to elevate comfort without sacrificing durability or style.

Partnering with Cobian offers affiliates a unique opportunity to connect with an audience that values high-quality products and a meaningful brand mission. Along with our ambassadors like Bethany Hamilton and partner organizations like Samaritan's Purse, we are dedicated to making a positive impact and using our platform to radiate the love of Jesus Christ through our faith-based Salt + Light mission. Join us in sharing the Cobian experience with the world and earn while promoting a brand built on comfort, quality, and a spirit of love.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Cobian Footwear! Thank you for joining our Affiliate Program.

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use products or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, you agree to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program Registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You must provide accurate and truthful information during registration. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

Affiliate links are automatically generated. You can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours will be the one that counts for the commission.

Affiliates might be assigned a coupon code, with details and usage clarified on the Dashboard. If a customer both clicks on the affiliate link and uses a coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliates may advertise the merchant’s website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, or offline channels like classified ads, magazines, and newspapers.

Advertising Restrictions: Affiliates are prohibited from bidding on Cobian brand or style name keywords. Additionally, the use of spammy tactics or deceptive marketing practices is strictly forbidden.

3. Commissions and Payment

When you refer a customer who makes a purchase on our website, you will earn a commission amount based on the Commission Structure. Commissions are calculated on the net sales amount, which is the order value minus any returns and excludes extra fees (tax, shipping costs, etc.).

To receive a commission, you must specify your payment details in the Settings. Payments will be made monthly, with a minimum payout threshold of $50. The payment schedule will be notified on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, which gives the merchant the right to review each referral order. The status of commissions is displayed in the Commission tab, and any paid commissions will be listed in the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing Tools

We may share promotional media such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions with you through the Marketing Tools tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, affiliates can invite others to become their downline affiliates. If any downline affiliate brings an order to the merchant shop, the upline affiliate will also earn a network commission, which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share your network link, and any affiliate who clicks on that link and signs up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookies

We use cookies to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to have cookies enabled for us to track them.

If a person doesn’t allow cookies or clears their cookies, we won’t be able to track them, and thus can’t pay earnings on that person’s activity.

The cookie duration is 30 days. The tracking period will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer on the merchant website will automatically result in commissions for the affiliate (the customer does not need to click on the affiliate link again).

7. Fraud Prevention

We have a zero-tolerance policy for fraudulent activity. Affiliates found engaging in fraudulent practices, such as generating fake sales or using unauthorized promotional methods, will be removed from the program immediately, and any pending commissions will be forfeited.

8. Dispute Resolution

In the event of a dispute regarding commissions or any other aspect of the affiliate program, the parties agree to first attempt to resolve the dispute through informal negotiation. If a resolution cannot be reached, the dispute will be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of [Arbitration Association/Local Arbitration Body].

9. Termination

Either party may terminate this agreement at any time with written notice. Upon termination, you will cease to use all promotional materials and links associated with the program. Commissions for transactions completed prior to termination will be paid out according to the standard payment schedule.

The merchant reserves the right to terminate an affiliate’s participation in the program for violations of these terms or any fraudulent or unethical conduct.

10. Removal from the Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: support@cobianusa.com.

Go forward and refer!

We’re very glad you’ve made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always revisit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future, and if you have any questions, you can email support@cobianusa.com for support.
